prs.title: fix(server): retire in-flight request state when the streamable HTTP transport closes
prs.author: rxits
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport.close() leaves in-flight JSON-response-mode POST requests unresolved: handleRequest()'s Promise<Response> is only ever settled by send(), and close() tears down _streamMapping/_requestResponseMap without resolving that promise, so the HTTP request hangs until the platform's own socket/timeout fires instead of getting an error response. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport.close() leaves in-flight JSON-response-mode POST requests unresolved: handleRequest()'s Promise<Response> is only ever settled by send(), and close() tears down _streamMapping/_requestResponseMap without resolving that promise, so the HTTP request hangs until the platform's own socket/timeout fires instead of getting an error response. members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2600: WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport.close() leaves in-flight JSON-response-mode POST requests unresolved: handleRequest()'s Promise<Response> is only ever settled by send(), and close() tears down _streamMapping/_requestResponseMap without resolving that promise, so the HTTP request hangs until the platform's own socket/timeout fires instead of getting an error response.
